_about: Which subway car (counted from the FRONT of the train, car 1 = front)
stops nearest the exit at each station, per direction of travel.
Transcribed by eye from the TTC Subway Rider Efficiency Guide
(Sean Lerner, ttc-rider.ca, 2005 platform survey). Like the guide,
this file is licensed CC BY-NC-SA 2.0, not the project's MIT license.
Positions are car-level estimates (+/- 1 car) and stations
renovated since 2005 may differ. Union is deliberately ABSENT - its
platforms were rebuilt in 2015 and the guide's data would be wrong.
Keys: station name lowercased, ' Station - ... Platform' stripped,
periods/apostrophes removed. Direction keys are the terminus the
train is heading toward (from the OTP leg headsign): vaughan/finch
for Line 1, kipling/kennedy for Line 2, donmills/sheppardyonge for
Line 4. 'of' = train length in cars (6, or 4 on Line 4).
'transfer' entries override the exit position when the NEXT leg is
another subway ride; keyed by next route number, or 'route:direction'
when the two onward directions have different stair positions.
